title: Documents: публичный state-контракт CollaborativeState (D27), pending marker и document_state_pending
summary: `Vaulter\Documents\State\CollaborativeState` (#[Api], реализация Internal) с DTO `LockedDocumentState`, `PendingMarker`, `CheckpointPublication`, `CheckpointOutcome`: `lock()` (T→N→D), `markPending()`, `publishCheckpoint()` (CAS generation/state_version, снятие marker только при PT ≤ H), `pendingDocuments()`; вне транзакции — LogicException. SPI `Vaulter\Documents\State\PendingStateDrainer` (#[Spi(Implement)], capability OptionalSingle в DocumentsModule). Колонки `v_documents.pending_generation`, `pending_through_seq` + CHECK (create-DDL DocumentsSchema, D21). Guards drain-or-409 `document_state_pending` (409, retryable with_backoff, receipt never) в REST PUT content, restore, export, GET content, purge документа (C8, C9). DocumentStateWriter остаётся Internal.
why: D26, D27, p5-design#invariants C5, C8, C9: documents владеет generation и marker; collaboration пишет только через публичный контракт; без marker REST тихо читает или перезаписывает устаревшую проекцию. Hard risks: снятие marker без покрытия (потеря saved-правок при restore/replace), deadlock при нарушении порядка T→N→D, ожидание drain внутри транзакции (locks на время хаба), stale JSON как актуальный.

Guards в UpdateDocumentContentAction, RestoreDocumentRevisionAction, экспорт, чтение content, DocumentContentLifecycle::purge

rules: Все методы CollaborativeState требуют открытой транзакции VaulterDatabase (иначе LogicException); lock() — единственная точка взятия T→N→D для collaboration.

Marker: оба поля NULL или оба NOT NULL (CHECK); markPending ставит max(PT, seq) только при generation == collab_epoch; publishCheckpoint снимает marker только при той же generation и coveredThrough ≥ PT.
Drain вызывается вне транзакции с deadline; после drain — повторный lock и проверка marker; marker не снят → 409 `document_state_pending`, collab_epoch не меняется.
При неактивном или отсутствующем drainer guards отвечают 409 без запросов к таблицам collaboration.
Публичная поверхность: CollaborativeState и DTO — #[Api]; PendingStateDrainer — #[Spi(Implement)]; DocumentStateWriter — #[Internal] без изменения метки.
guidance: PendingMarkerRaceTest (pgsql, serial, ForkRace из кита): процесс A — markPending(seq=H+1) после чтения H процессом B; процесс B — publishCheckpoint(coveredThrough=H). Ожидание в любом порядке commit: marker остаётся (PT = H+1). Тест пишется и классифицируется, в PLAN3 не исполняется. На sqlite те же утверждения — детерминированным чередованием вызовов в CollaborativeStateTest.

result.notes:
Correction round 3 of the P5.3 review fixes. F2 fixed: PendingStateGuard::drainTrashed() no longer drains a fixed batch (orderBy id, limit 100). It reads every marked trashed document of the drive in keyset pages of 100 (id > last) and drains each one once per call, so documents whose drain never settles cannot starve the purge target; the constant is renamed PURGE_DRAIN_PAGE. F1 (retention purge and drive purge step) cannot be fixed inside documents and is reported as a deviation owned by drive. PurgeTrashCommand::runMaintenance and PurgeDriveStepAction call PurgeNodeAction in transactions of their own, outside OperationRunner, so the OperationMiddleware seam (PendingPurgeDrain) never runs. A drain before those transactions needs a drive-side pre-transaction purge hook, i.e. a new or changed drive SPI and slot, an architecture change that needs a D#. PendingStateGuardTest: the test helper guardSettle() now publishes a covering checkpoint (the fake drainer reuses it). New cases: (1) F2 regression: 101 stuck marked trashed documents with lower ids plus a publishing drainer for the target; the purge drains all 102 once each and removes the target. (2) Retention purge (artisan vaulter:trash:purge --days=0) of a pending trashed document exits 1, keeps the document and never calls the drainer; after guardSettle() the next run exits 0 and removes it. (3) Drive purge step (PurgeDriveStepAction, drive status Deleting) throws DocumentStatePendingException, keeps the document and never calls the drainer; after guardSettle() it returns true and the document is gone. Runs, all exit 0 on sqlite: scripts/t sqlite -p documents tests/State/PendingStateGuardTest.php; scripts/t sqlite -p documents tests/State tests/Arch (35 State tests); scripts/t baseline --write -p documents then --compare -p documents (current 718, added 57).

deviations: F1 not fixed in documents: retention (PurgeTrashCommand::runMaintenance, its own transaction around PurgeNodeAction) and the drive purge step (PurgeDriveStepAction → PurgeNodeAction's own transaction) bypass OperationRunner, so no documents-side hook can drain before their transaction. While a marker is set, both refuse with document_state_pending (rolled back, nothing removed) and never call the drainer. They converge once the marker is cleared: the next retention run or drive-purge step succeeds (pinned by two PendingStateGuardTest cases). A real drain-or-409 there needs a drive-owned pre-transaction purge hook, a new drive SPI and slot (D8, needs a D#), or running those purges through OperationRunner as 'drive.trash.purge'. That is outside the documents write set and changes drive's architecture.
